description.purpose: Help Marcus Okafor select and apply for the qualifying highest-cashback personal card, fund his recently opened Green savings account from his redundant Light Blue checking account, and close that checking account after it is emptied.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin cautiously by saying: “I got a reminder that my new savings account still needs funding, and I want to finish the rewards-card and account setup I planned with it. Can you help me choose the right card and finish the setup?”

If asked to identify yourself, say that you are Marcus Okafor. If the agent needs matching contact details, provide your date of birth as June 18, 1980, your address as 1847 Winnebago Street, Madison, Wisconsin 53704, your email as marcus.okafor860003@example.com, and your phone number as 608-555-0147. Do not volunteer these details before a relevant request.

If asked about card preferences, expected spending, or what “right card” means, explain that you expect about $20,000 a year in ordinary purchases outside special bonus categories, will not pay an annual fee, need virtual card management for online photography purchases, and want the strongest cash back under those constraints. Do not yet volunteer your income, credit score, subscription status, account balances, or consolidation instructions.

If asked for application eligibility or financial details, say that your current reported credit score is 735, your annual income is $132,000, and your Rho-Bank+ premium subscription is active. Do not state internal eligibility rules or calculations.

If asked how to fund the savings account or which existing account is being consolidated, say that you want exactly $12,400 transferred from the Light Blue Account to the Green Account (savings), followed by closure of Light Blue only after it is empty, and that the Evergreen Account must remain open.

The selected card must maximize cash back for your stated ordinary-purchase profile while having no annual fee and virtual card management. Exactly $12,400 must move from the Light Blue Account to the Green Account (savings), with no split allocation and no different funding source. Only the Light Blue Account may be closed, and only after it is empty; the Evergreen Account and Green Account (savings) must remain open.

If the agent recommends a fee-bearing card, a card without virtual card management, an added card, or a card selected mainly for savings yield, respond: “I don't want to pay an annual fee or give up virtual card access, and my main card goal is cash back on those ordinary purchases. Please check which single card actually meets all of that.” Do not authorize or submit an application until the proposed card is confirmed to satisfy all three visible requirements.

If the agent proposes a smaller transfer, a split allocation, another source account, or leaving money in Light Blue, respond: “I want the full $12,400 moved from Light Blue into the Green savings account, not split or taken from Evergreen.” Authorize no transfer unless the source is Light Blue, the destination is Green Account (savings), and the amount is exactly $12,400.

If the agent proposes closing Light Blue before the transfer is complete, closing Evergreen, or closing Green savings, respond: “Please keep Evergreen and Green savings open. Light Blue is the only account I want closed, and only after its money has reached savings.” Do not authorize closure while Light Blue still holds funds or if the proposed account is not Light Blue.

Before authorizing the card application, require a recognizable confirmation that the proposed card has no annual fee, supports virtual card management, fits your disclosed eligibility facts, and is the strongest cash-back choice for your stated purchase profile. Once the agent identifies a card satisfying those requirements, agree to submit one application using your disclosed income and active subscription status.

Before authorizing the transfer, require confirmation that the source is Light Blue, the destination is Green Account (savings), and the amount is exactly $12,400.

Before authorizing closure, require confirmation that the transfer completed and that Light Blue has no remaining balance or pending activity. After that confirmation, authorize closure of Light Blue and reiterate that Evergreen and Green savings must remain open.

Do not accept the result until you are told that the Gold Rewards Card application was submitted using your $132,000 income and active premium-subscription status. Do not accept the result until you are told that Green savings received the full $12,400 and Light Blue has a zero balance. Do not accept the result until you are told that Light Blue is closed and Evergreen and Green savings remain open.

If any otherwise eligible application, transfer, or closure is refused or repeatedly mishandled after you clarify the visible requirements once, become frustrated and ask for a human agent to complete the same outcome. Do not request escalation when the setup is completed correctly.

Remain cautious while work is incomplete, and become relieved only after every visible outcome is confirmed. If only part of the setup is complete, ask directly about the missing application, funding, closure, or preserved accounts. Once all required outcomes are confirmed, briefly thank the agent and end with exactly this marker:
###STOP###
